title: Game research discovery
summary: Review 26 game-specific reverse engineering and resource projects.
notes: Personally screened the current catalogue and reviewed pinned primary README files. Most qualifying discoveries are DOS game format research; broad Amiga and Atari ST searches primarily returned tracked projects or forks. No independent builds, executions or binary comparisons.

sources.reason: Documents animation containers and game tables; measurements and scripts, not a reconstructed engine.
Studies the GOG installation, disc structure and four containers with reproducible measurement scripts.
Documents the PC front end, resource container, LZW codec and display layer; chess search is not analysed.
Studies the DOS release, Z-machine story header, compressed text and interpreter.
Studies the DOS archive, LZW and game-specific formats with analysis tools.
Documents retail DOS resources, executable data, Huffman archive, maps and page files.
Studies DOS resources and compressed archives, rendering and decoding game assets.
Documents the game loader and compression codec with tools and rendered screens.
Studies game files, graphics and other data formats with reproducible scripts.
Studies the executable packer and game resources, including levels and animation.
Documents the HXG archive and compression, with resource decoding tools.
Studies the DOS interpreter, story format, text and sound, with reproducible scripts.
Studies the resource container and its index, audio and script data using analysis tools.
Studies an Italian CD edition's resource index, image codec, scripts and speech container.
Studies the DOS release's PAK and DAT formats and executable compression.
Documents game resource container, image codec, text, levels and sprites.
Studies DOS containers, compression, images and scripts, with tools.
Studies DOS resource archives and game data, with reproducible tools.
Documents WACKY.DAT, track and sprite formats and renderer lookup tables.
Studies game data containers, packed members and palette format.
Studies game files, animation container and other data formats with analysis scripts.
Detokenized BASIC source from the DOS version; no independent reconstruction or build was performed.
Unpacks BACKS.BIN and MOTIVS.BIN game resources.
Decodes, re-encodes and repacks the game's FVF videos; in-game tests are author reports.
Annotated, cross-referenced game disassembly and supporting documentation; no independent build or parity test.
Edits game text, quests, maps and graphics, including support for packed files; not an engine reconstruction.
